close_reason: false positive: the clone is required — commit 0bc07f47 restored it precisely because removing it was a regression; revoked_certificates is Option<Vec<...>> and must be cloned to return an owned Vec
description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs verify_delta_crl_and_collect (around line 544) ends with:

    Ok(delta_crl
        .tbs_cert_list
        .revoked_certificates
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_default())

This clones every RevokedCert entry from the delta CRL into a new Vec<RevokedCert> on every check_revocation call. The caller immediately converts the result to a slice (&delta_entries) and passes it to check_revocation_status, which only reads it.

For large CRLs this is O(N) allocation + copy per check. The clone compounds the already-documented O(N) re-parse on every call (tracked for v0.3).

The fix is to change the signature to return a reference to the slice:

    fn verify_delta_crl_and_collect<'crl>(delta_crl: &'crl CertificateList, ...) -> Result<&'crl [RevokedCert]>

then use .as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]) instead of .clone().unwrap_or_default().

The lifetime would need to thread through the caller in check_revocation/check_revocation_against_anchor (the delta_crl lives long enough since it is parsed just above the call and lives to the end of the function).

Category: R5 (cloning entire Vec where only a slice is needed)
title: rusty: verify_delta_crl_and_collect clones entire revoked-cert Vec
